title: Lost Mary BM600 Menthol Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Menthol offers a clean, refreshing vape with no added fruit or sweetness—just a brisk, icy-cool sensation from start to finish. Ideal for purists, this flavour delivers a crisp, cooling hit with every puff, making it a great choice for those who enjoy a sharp, punchy, no-nonsense Menthol profile. These pods are designed exclusively for use with the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit. Each twin pack contains two prefilled 2ml pods, loaded with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid for a smooth throat hit and fast-acting satisfaction when used with an MTL (mouth-to-lung) device. Each pod delivers up to 600 puffs depending on your vaping habits. Once empty, simply swap in a new pod for uninterrupted, fuss-free vaping.
